tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and 3D scene background behind every panel.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Glass HUD panels over the 3D scene. Always pair with blur-panel.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Hover, selected row, pressed segment, quiet button fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders and dividers. Hairline only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel and chip.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: task lines, timestamps, counts. 4.6:1 or more on bg, panel and chip.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action (Approve, Retry), focus ring, routine markers.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: emphasis
tokens.usage: The 10% color: alerts and the one key action in a decision (Approve on a request, unread counts, room alert beacons). In Day and Night it equals accent; in Sublevel it is red. Never a fill larger than a button.

tokens.name: on-emphasis
tokens.usage: Text on emphasis.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a status fill (danger button, check in the finished bubble).

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Fill of status bubbles and speech bubbles over bots, in 2D and 3D.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Bot is working. Dot, bubble glyph, monitor glow.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: Bot needs a human decision. Always shows in Waiting on me.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Bot failed. Always shows in Waiting on me with Retry.

tokens.name: status-resting
tokens.usage: Bot is idle in the lounge.

tokens.name: status-finished
tokens.usage: Bot finished a task; check bubble at the desk.

tokens.name: status-working-text
tokens.usage: Text color for the working status on bg, panel and chip. 4.5:1 or more. Use it for a status word. Dot and fill use status-working.

tokens.name: status-waiting-text
tokens.usage: Text color for the waiting status on bg, panel and chip. 4.5:1 or more. Use it for a status word. Dot and fill use status-waiting.

tokens.name: status-error-text
tokens.usage: Text color for the error status on bg, panel and chip. 4.5:1 or more. Use it for a status word. Dot and fill use status-error.

tokens.name: status-resting-text
tokens.usage: Text color for the resting status on bg, panel and chip. 4.5:1 or more. Use it for a status word. Dot and fill use status-resting.

tokens.name: status-finished-text
tokens.usage: Text color for the finished status on bg, panel and chip. 4.5:1 or more. Use it for a status word. Dot and fill use status-finished.

tokens.name: status-working-on-bubble
tokens.usage: Text color for the working status on bubble (a light face in every theme). 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: status-waiting-on-bubble
tokens.usage: Text color for the waiting status on bubble (a light face in every theme). 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: status-error-on-bubble
tokens.usage: Text color for the error status on bubble (a light face in every theme). 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: status-resting-on-bubble
tokens.usage: Text color for the resting status on bubble (a light face in every theme). 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: status-finished-on-bubble
tokens.usage: Text color for the finished status on bubble (a light face in every theme). 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: floor-ops
tokens.usage: Floor 1 identity. Roster header fill, building-view floor band; white text on it.

tokens.name: floor-sales
tokens.usage: Floor 2 identity. Roster header fill; white text on it.

tokens.name: floor-research
tokens.usage: Floor 3 identity. Roster header fill; white text on it.

tokens.name: floor-content
tokens.usage: Floor 4 identity. Roster header fill; white text on it.

tokens.name: floor-hq
tokens.usage: Floor 5 (HQ) identity. Roster header fill; white text on it.

tokens.name: on-floor
tokens.usage: Text on any floor-* fill. 4.9:1 or more.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dark veil behind a dialog or the command palette. Mix it with transparent: color-mix(in srgb, var(--scrim) 45%, transparent).

tokens.name: type-team
tokens.usage: Office type: team floor. Type badge dot, room icon, the stripe on the room floor edge.

tokens.name: type-lab
tokens.usage: Office type: lab / server room.

tokens.name: type-studio
tokens.usage: Office type: studio.

tokens.name: type-hq
tokens.usage: Office type: war room / HQ.

tokens.name: scene-floor
tokens.usage: 3D floor slab top.

tokens.name: scene-wall
tokens.usage: 3D back wall.

tokens.name: scene-wood
tokens.usage: 3D desk tops and side tables.

tokens.name: scene-chair
tokens.usage: 3D chairs and sofas.

tokens.name: scene-rug
tokens.usage: 3D lounge rug. Marks the resting zone.

tokens.name: scene-wall-side
tokens.usage: 3D left wall. One step darker than scene-wall so the corner reads.

tokens.name: scene-slab
tokens.usage: 3D floor slab edge and kit plinths.

tokens.name: scene-rail
tokens.usage: 3D front railing slats.

tokens.name: scene-sofa
tokens.usage: 3D lounge sofas.

tokens.name: scene-metal
tokens.usage: 3D desk pedestals and bases.

tokens.name: scene-dark
tokens.usage: 3D monitors, lamps, racks, tripods.

tokens.name: scene-glass
tokens.usage: 3D glass partitions between rooms and the room boxes in the building view. Used at 22–28% opacity.

tokens.name: scene-subagent
tokens.usage: 3D body of a temporary subagent. Grey so it reads as on loan; it leaves when it returns.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Building name in docs and empty states. Never in the HUD.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Room and floor names in large panels.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: App name, bot names in headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status line under a row name. Color muted.

styles.name: sl-sign
styles.usage: Room signs, floor names and panel heads in Sublevel. Always uppercase.

styles.name: sl-name
styles.usage: Bot names, times and data in Sublevel.

styles.name: sl-terminal
styles.usage: Big figures and CRT numbers. Never for words longer than a label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Pip gaps, icon-to-text in dots.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in a column; row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding (sides).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter. Minimum on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between HUD columns and the scene edge on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps in docs and cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, floor number badge.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, segments.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, bubbles.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Every floating HUD panel. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: blur-panel
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on every panel so the scene shows through.

tokens.name: opacity-glass
tokens.usage: 3D glass partitions and building-view room boxes.

tokens.name: opacity-resting
tokens.usage: Status bubble of a resting bot.

zIndex.note: Layers from back to front. Use only these values.

tokens.name: z-scene
tokens.usage: The 3D canvas.

tokens.name: z-tag
tokens.usage: Labels drawn over the scene.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: HUD panels over the scene.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Phone bottom sheet, pickers and menus.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and its overlay.

duration.note: Motion durations in ms. The 3D engine reads duration-floor, duration-camera, duration-speech, duration-handoff, duration-tool-label, duration-elevator, duration-packet and duration-intro.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles, tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panels, chat open, toasts in.

tokens.name: duration-floor
tokens.usage: A floor rises into view. Read by the 3D engine.

tokens.name: duration-camera
tokens.usage: The camera glides to a floor, a room or the building. Read by the 3D engine.

tokens.name: duration-speech
tokens.usage: A speech bubble stays over a bot. Read by the 3D engine.

tokens.name: duration-handoff
tokens.usage: A hand-off line flies and fades between two bots. Read by the 3D engine.

tokens.name: duration-tool-label
tokens.usage: A tool name stays over a bot. Read by the 3D engine.

tokens.name: duration-toast
tokens.usage: A toast stays on screen.

tokens.name: duration-elevator
tokens.usage: The elevator ride between two floors. Read by the 3D engine.

tokens.name: duration-packet
tokens.usage: A tool-call packet rides the cable tray one way. Read by the 3D engine.

tokens.name: duration-intro
tokens.usage: The intro flythrough from the tower to the first floor. Read by the 3D engine.

tokens.name: duration-fly
tokens.usage: A bot portrait flies from the scene into the agent panel.

easing.note: Easing curves. Use ease-out for things that arrive, ease-in for things that leave.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Floors, panels and toasts that arrive.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things that leave.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: State changes in place.

tokens.name: ease-walk
tokens.usage: Bots walking on the aisle.

breakpoint.note: Layout breakpoints for the office HUD (container width).

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: At this width and below: floor chips, one bottom sheet, no room list, queue, log, broadcast or usage.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: At this width and below: the activity log hides and the broadcast bar moves left.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: The reference width for previews and the full HUD.

scene.note: 3D layout in scene units (1 unit is about 0.5 m). The engine reads these on mount.

tokens.name: scene-depth
tokens.usage: Room depth.

tokens.name: scene-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between workstations in a row.

tokens.name: scene-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between rooms on a floor.

tokens.name: scene-floor-gap
tokens.usage: Height between floors in the building view.

tokens.name: scene-handoff-dash
tokens.usage: Dash length of the hand-off line.

tokens.name: scene-handoff-gap
tokens.usage: Gap length of the hand-off line.

tokens.name: scene-wall-h
tokens.usage: Wall height.

tokens.name: scene-bot-h
tokens.usage: Bot height. Desk top 0.95, seat 0.6.

tokens.name: scene-nav-pad
tokens.usage: Clearance between a walking bot and any object. The nav grid grows every obstacle by this value.

tokens.name: scene-nav-cell
tokens.usage: Cell size of the nav grid that bots path on.

light.note: 3D light levels for each theme (0 to 2). The engine reads these.

tokens.name: light-day-sky
tokens.usage: Sky light in Day.

tokens.name: light-day-sun
tokens.usage: Sun in Day, from the front right.

tokens.name: light-day-lamp
tokens.usage: Room lamps in Day: off.

tokens.name: light-night-sky
tokens.usage: Sky light in Night.

tokens.name: light-night-sun
tokens.usage: Moon in Night.

tokens.name: light-night-lamp
tokens.usage: Warm room lamps in Night.

tokens.name: light-sublevel-sky
tokens.usage: Fluorescent fill in Sublevel.

tokens.name: light-sublevel-sun
tokens.usage: Ceiling key light in Sublevel, from above.

tokens.name: light-sublevel-lamp
tokens.usage: Room lamps in Sublevel: off.

fx.note: 3D post effects (0 to 2). The engine reads these on mount and when the theme changes. Quality "low" turns post effects off.

tokens.name: fx-bloom-day
tokens.usage: Bloom strength in Day.

tokens.name: fx-bloom-night
tokens.usage: Bloom strength in Night: screens, lamps, windows, packets and beacons glow.

tokens.name: fx-bloom-sublevel
tokens.usage: Bloom strength in Sublevel.

tokens.name: fx-threshold-day
tokens.usage: Light level where bloom starts in Day. Above white, so walls do not glow.

tokens.name: fx-threshold-night
tokens.usage: Light level where bloom starts in Night.

tokens.name: fx-threshold-sublevel
tokens.usage: Light level where bloom starts in Sublevel.

tokens.name: fx-exposure-day
tokens.usage: Exposure in Day.

tokens.name: fx-exposure-night
tokens.usage: Exposure in Night.

tokens.name: fx-exposure-sublevel
tokens.usage: Exposure in Sublevel.

tokens.name: fx-fog-day
tokens.usage: Depth haze in Day: off.

tokens.name: fx-fog-night
tokens.usage: Depth haze in Night, in the bg color.

tokens.name: fx-fog-sublevel
tokens.usage: Depth haze in Sublevel.

tokens.name: fx-bloom-radius
tokens.usage: Bloom spread.

tokens.name: fx-knee
tokens.usage: Highlight roll-off: light above this level compresses softly, light below keeps the token color.

tokens.name: fx-vignette-day
tokens.usage: Corner darkening in Day: off, so the scene edge meets the page bg.

tokens.name: fx-vignette-night
tokens.usage: Corner darkening in Night.

tokens.name: fx-vignette-sublevel
tokens.usage: Corner darkening in Sublevel.
